subject: Post-call recap + proposal: weekly lattice rotation for demo windows
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Green <sam.greenlane@example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposal: weekly lattice rotation for demo windows

Hi Sam — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

- Recap: You highlighted three priorities: predictable latency for embedding lookups, per-route cost visibility, and secure VPC deployment for PHI-scoped docs.
- Ask: We want to schedule a technical deep dive (30–45m) with your infra/IT lead and engineer who owns the embedding pipeline so we can map a canary deployment and sizing.

To make scheduling easier across your distributed team, I sketched a lightweight rotating-week proposal (attached). Idea in short: rotate which region gets the ‘prime’ weekly slot so US/EU/APAC stakeholders each get a time that’s friendly to them on a repeating 3-week cadence. This keeps one predictable slot for hands-on engineering review without forcing the same timezone every week.

Proposed cadence (examples):
- Week A (US-friendly): Tue 10:00 PT / Tue 13:00 ET
- Week B (EU-friendly): Wed 16:00 BST / Wed 17:00 CEST
- Week C (APAC-friendly): Thu 09:00 SGT / Thu 11:00 AEST

Action items:
1) Can you share 2 preferred weeks for the first two deep dives (options are in-line or I can send a calendar poll)?
2) Please confirm the external attendees we should include (IT Ops, platform engineer, security).
3) I attached a simple availability-grid.xlsx — we can adjust cadence if your team prefers bi-weekly or monthly instead.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf, availability-grid.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Sam Green <sam.greenlane@example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Ops <itops@greenlane.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 10:09:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposal: weekly lattice rotation for demo windows

Ben — thanks for the recap, that matches my notes. IT Ops (cc'd) will need to be on the technical deep dive. A couple of quick constraints from our side: 

- We prefer mid-week slots where possible (Tue–Thu).
- Our platform engineer (A. Li) is only available mornings PT / late afternoons CEST.
- Security lead can join asynchronously but would like the recording and the proposed config before the call.

Available windows for the next three weeks (all in their local times):
- Week of Aug 25: Tue 11:00–13:00 PT or Wed 15:00–17:00 CEST
- Week of Sep 1: Wed 16:00–18:00 BST or Thu 09:00–11:00 SGT
- Week of Sep 8: Tue 09:00–11:00 PT or Thu 17:00–19:00 CEST

If you can lock two sessions (one earlier, one ~2 weeks later) I can make sure the right engineers are on the invite. Please include a short agenda and the perf/cost metrics we talked about.

Sam
Sam Green
Head of Data Platform | Greenlane Health
sam.greenlane@example.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Green <sam.greenlane@example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, IT Ops <itops@greenlane.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposal: weekly lattice rotation for demo windows

Thanks Sam — perfect, appreciate the availability. Based on what you sent, here are two concrete options to pick from. I’ve attached an updated availability-grid with candidate calendar invites.

Option 1 (sooner):
- Tue Aug 26 — 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (US-friendly slot) — 45m deep dive — target: infra + platform engineer

Option 2 (staggered):
- Wed Sep 3 — 16:00 BST / 17:00 CEST (EU-friendly slot) — 45m deep dive — target: infra + security + IT Ops

Proposed repeating lattice (if this works for you): rotate these prime slots on a 3-week cycle so each region gets a hands-on slot roughly once per three weeks. That keeps momentum while sharing the burden across timezones.

Agenda (short):
- 5m: Introductions & success criteria
- 15m: Walkthrough of embedding latency & caching (Vivek)
- 15m: Capacity/replication & VPC network requirements (Marissa)
- 10m: Next steps / rollout plan + action owners

If either option works, I’ll send invites and include a short pre-read (perf snapshot + config ask). Please confirm attendees for Aug 26 and whether A. Li can make that call.

Attachments: availability-grid.xlsx

—
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 09:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + proposal: weekly lattice rotation for demo windows

Looping you both in on Sam's confirmed constraints and the two options I proposed. Marissa — can you prepare the VPC checklist and a short note on required logs/retention for the Sept 3 session (security will want that ahead of time). Vivek — will you lead the embedding perf deep dive on Aug 26?

I'll finalize invites once I hear back from Sam about Aug 26 attendee list. Keeping the cadence flexible — if Aug 26 doesn't work, we'll move to Sep 3 as the EU-friendly kickoff.

Thanks —
Ben
